program='''def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid[0])
    center = n // 2
    out = [[0 for _ in range(n)] for _ in range(n)]
    for r in range(n):
        for c in (center - r, center + r):
            if 0 <= c < n:
                out[r][c] = 2
        if r >= 3:
            for c in range(n):
                if abs(c - center) <= r - 2 and (c - r) % 4 == 2:
                    out[r][c] = 1
    return out
'''
